family: llf_cd_confirm_v1 reviewer-defence analysis on the sealed-12 (descriptive, no label)

_why.primary_metric: The node's Secondary puts 'the after-360 s row beside the whole run', so the primary is the whole run (d_read reads the whole-run per-task mean).
_why.runaway_metric: 'A cell is a runaway if it is > 10x its arm's median': the cell's own value, so the 10x test uses the statistic being read (whole for the primary, a360 for the a360 rows).
_why.arm_median_pool: 'its arm's median in that rung': the arm is the kind; d_read (d_fsl3) took the median over all of the arm's cells in the load, seeds pooled.
_why.runaway_unit: The unit of the statistic is the seed-mean learned cell, and the node drops 'a pair when either cell is flagged': a runaway seed contaminates the mean, so the cell is flagged and the pair dropped (no reweighting the node does not describe).
_why.no_window_left: 'per topology the median over the 2 windows' has no value when both pairs are dropped; the topology leaves that contrast's median, sign count and Wilcoxon.
_why.weaker_order: 'The label is the weaker of the two readings': weaker for the MP claim, as the P9 precedent (uncut_arm_gate_read.TW_ORDER), strongest first.
_why.not_slower_than_mlp_pct: 'the gnn is not slower than the MLP on either rung': the gnn-vs-MLP median <= 0 % on both rungs, in the reading being labelled.
_why.seed_clause_reading: 'each seed alone gives a median <= -1 %': seed-matched gnn s vs twin s, on both rungs (the clause sits under 'on both rungs'), in the reading being labelled.
_why.mp_direction_min_faster: '>= 8/12 topologies faster': a count of 8, kept at 8 when drops leave fewer than 12 (it becomes harder, never easier).

_mapping.a: 'v7 gnn / twin / MLP / wide' are the selected variant's arms (A1 selection 2026-10-24: STATIC), A6 40-epoch: gnn_static, twin_static, mlp_static, wide_static (A3: under (a), the wide-MLP control is wide_static). The MP-ATTRIBUTED MLP clause uses mlp_static. The v6 fslabel arms and the bar are references. A3 also keeps the v7 MLP and v7 wide MLP as pointwise references under (a); this reader does not include them, so they are not part of this read.
_mapping.b: Confirmed from the node text: a learned cell is the mean over seeds of the per-seed cell value (the whole-run task mean, or the after-360 mean for the a360 rows), and the paired % is taken on those seed means. This is not the P9 per-seed pairing, except in the seed clause, which is seed-matched by its own words.
